high_alert_reason: ISMP high-alert: anticoagulant. Dose errors cause major bleeding or therapeutic failure. Requires independent two-nurse verification on initiation, bag change, and bolus.
adult_dose: DVT/PE: bolus 80 units/kg (max 10,000 units), infusion 18 units/kg/hr, titrate to aPTT 1.5–2.5× control per institutional nomogram. ACS: bolus 60 units/kg (max 4,000 units), infusion 12 units/kg/hr.
pediatric_dose: Bolus 75 units/kg, infusion 20 units/kg/hr (age < 1yr) or 18 units/kg/hr (≥1yr); titrate per institutional nomogram.
max_dose: Initial bolus typically capped at 10,000 units; individual infusion rates titrated to aPTT, not to a fixed maximum.
contraindications: Recent neurosurgery or uncontrolled severe hypertension
key_monitoring: aPTT q6h until two consecutive therapeutic values, then q24h
Platelet count q48h for HIT surveillance
Clinical bleeding assessment (gums, urine, stool, IV sites, neuro exam)

provenance.source: CHEST anticoagulation guidelines + ISMP high-alert list + Lexicomp summary
